values.note: Forest Service: 'All site reservations are made via recreation.gov.' recreation.gov books at most 7 nights in a rolling 30 days; the campground's camping limit is 16 consecutive days at one site and 32 days a year. Outside the reservable season recreation.gov's rate table lists first-come, first-served seasons (April 15 - May 14, September 16 - November 30), paid in cash or check.

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Madison RD) campground on a dense Douglas-fir hillside above spring-fed Wade Lake in the Cliff/Wade Lakes area, ~37 mi south of Ennis via US-287 and FR 241. Narrow roads and tight curves; in the upper loop the only flat tent space may be the parking spur. Natural-surface boat launch, no-wake lake. Snow may hinder access early and late in the season. --Claude
